gloss: to burn; to scorch; to char

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {焦|こ}がしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to burn; to scorch; to char
definitions.explanation: To apply too much heat to something, causing it to become burnt or charred on the surface. Often refers to accidentally burning food while cooking.

definitions.gloss: to be consumed by (emotion); to be burning with
definitions.explanation: To be intensely preoccupied or tormented by a strong emotion such as longing, jealousy, or impatience.

examples.japanese: フライパンで{肉|にく}を{焦|こ}がしてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally burned the meat in the frying pan.

examples.japanese: パンを{焦|こ}がさないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to burn the bread.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}を{火|ひ}にかけたまま{忘|わす}れて、{底|そこ}を{焦|こ}がしてしまった。
examples.english: I forgot the pot on the stove and scorched the bottom.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{嫉妬|しっと}で{身|み}を{焦|こ}がしている。
{恋|こい}に{身|み}を{焦|こ}がす{日々|ひび}を{過|す}ごしている。
examples.english: I'm spending my days burning with love.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}への{思|おも}いに{胸|むね}を{焦|こ}がしながら、{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: Burning with longing for her, I wrote a letter.

notes:
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がさない (negative)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がして (te-form)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がした (past)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がせる (potential)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がされる (passive)

TRANSITIVITY:
{焦|こ}がす is transitive: someone burns something.
Intransitive pair: {焦|こ}げる (to get burnt, to scorch)
・パンを{焦|こ}がした (I burned the bread) - transitive
・パンが{焦|こ}げた (The bread got burned) - intransitive

Sense 2 USAGE:
{身|み}を{焦|こ}がす - to be consumed/tormented by (emotion)
・{恋|こい}に{身|み}を{焦|こ}がす (to be burning with love)
・{嫉妬|しっと}に{身|み}を{焦|こ}がす (to be consumed by jealousy)
